name: pin-past-the-head-answers-not-found
description: Epoch history (#483, SPEC §7.1.2.2): a pinned locator whose epoch exceeds the session's head names a record that does not exist — the same NOT_FOUND on -32002, detail-free, that a missing session answers. Nothing about the head's value may leak through the error shape: a caller must not be able to binary-search the history depth off error variance.
